content.overview: Section 37 specifies the orders from which an appeal lies under Part I, including specified orders concerning refusal to refer parties to arbitration, grant/refusal of section 9 relief, tribunal constitution, and specified section 34 outcomes. No second appeal lies except to the Supreme Court on a substantial question of law.
